decisions.reason: As a 2024 extension of the firm’s established automation offer in a growing, R&D-active business, it is likely to be retained because it fits the announced direction and can still be justified as needing more time to scale.

This product also builds on the core portfolio and benefits from the firm’s expansion and investment posture, so management has some commitment to continue even though the public commitment appears limited.

Although more distant from the traditional offer, it was presented as a flagship and won a visible design award, so the firm is strongly committed and is especially unlikely to withdraw it soon because doing so would contradict its public strategic push and write off a salient investment.
